findings.finding: Both installed SDK revisions already configure tipsOnly:true. Fresh genesis-to-tip synchronization skips the historical block download loop. Treating initial sync as necessarily linear metadata replay would motivate unnecessary synchronization machinery.
findings.requiredDisposition: Keep normal supported initial sync. Measure its actual tip/header requests on a fresh store first. Do not add an initial-sync paging platform. Retained-store fork walk-back, rollback rows and full contract discovery remain separate history-sensitive work.

minimumTransportChunk.interface: Constructor captures exact trusted endpoint/network/proof policy/tier/context capability. read accepts only detached own-data number/hash plus separately reviewed cancellation/deadline controls. Tier is not a per-request override.
rules: Exact fixed route only, no query string or caller URL/headers/account/tag/selector/filter fields. No change to generic RPC schema or padded getBlock fallback.

Request <=1024 bytes and decoded response stream <=2MiB before JSON/SDK decoding. Reject bad content-type/UTF-8/shape/count/duplicate input ambiguity, oversize declared and streamed sizes; cancel and drain rejected streams.

Gateway enforces exact allowed Origin before stripping it for fixed loopback native forwarding. Preserve service trust configuration; CORS is not user authentication and no new bearer/identity claim is inferred. Native route registration remains a separate parent-owned change.

Readiness and exact expected network/proofs/tier before and after upstream read. Client failure/context/abort must suppress output, retain ownership until all underlying promises/stream work settle and release the single-flight slot only then. No retries, redirects, cookies or arbitrary response/error text.

Client response is untrusted transport data; downstream authenticateCompactBlock against an independently canonical header is mandatory. Fixed route/TLS/JSON shape do not authenticate ordinal or root.

Tests should exercise actual stream byte caps and error drainage, late account switch, wrong origin/path/network/tier, redirects, aborted response, blocked concurrency and no underlying SDK/padded call. No production registration in this four-file chunk.

sdkCursorAndHeadSeam.assessment: Feasible as a narrowly fixed scoped capability over the existing queue/coordinator. Avoid a second general orchestration platform.
requirements: One SDK-owned epoch per exact account/network/rollup/class/artifact/database incarnation/target anchor; caller cursor fields alone cannot authorize resumed progress.

Gap-free physical block/transaction/log scan including empty/unrelated positions. At most8 ciphertexts per utility operation; full block authentication remains protocol-bounded and needs cost measurement. Reuse only an immutable verified-block capability with canonical rechecks.

Atomic SDK checkpoint and page note/event commit, using one coordinator transaction. Lost response and same-store restart must recover committed position/records without duplicate fold or unearned advancement; fresh-store backup cannot carry an ahead cursor.

Return only records original EventService authenticated and actually committed. Use SDK tx ordinal/eventIndex metadata for deterministic replay; do not equate physical log position or admitted count with event order/durable success. Bounded transaction-local buffering is sufficient if a page splits an event sequence.

A fixed head utility after complete scan may avoid generic ensureContractSynced only for this exact authenticated class and scope; preserve NHK key gate and original validators. Legitimate fully scanned uninitialized state differs from initialized/missing head. Dense revision/digest fold must equal authenticated final active head.

Existing block-range query limits cannot paginate inside a dense block and may inspect unrelated scoped records. Use exact committed page-record positions at the SDK boundary instead of repeatedly querying full blocks or exposing raw stores to application code.

For incremental epochs refresh only exact preference-head candidates under original anchored nullifier validation, in bounded batches. Do not call generic syncNoteNullifiers over all active contract notes, omit nullifiers, or discard historical nullified-note provenance needed for reorg de-nullification.

Recovery checkpoint must roll back or invalidate with both note/event stores on orphaning. After commit, fold CAS and before publication recheck canonical target/account generation; no external-chain atomicity claim.

A recovery-only production entry must defer constructor simulation, account status/deposit/names reads that trigger normal contract discovery. Keep ordinary financial paths unchanged and never globally mark contract synced.

remainingBoundedness.freshInitialSync: Supported tips-only mechanism exists; measure before changing.
remainingBoundedness.retainedReorg: Walk-back can scale with fork depth; event/note rollback currently gathers orphan rows. Do not claim strict per-step latency for these paths without measured bounds or reviewed incremental semantics.
remainingBoundedness.headNullifiers: Current validateAndStoreNotes checks recovered heads at real anchor and preserves spent metadata; anchor advancement requires bounded candidate refresh.
remainingBoundedness.materializedPreferences: Fold state/encrypted snapshot naturally scales with current preferences. Explicitly measure/report this separately from bounded page work; no permanent preference-count cap or silent truncation.
remainingBoundedness.capacity: Whole-block root hashing and actual encrypted ACIR cold ingestion need independent measures. Existing warm1k/10k/50k query results do not qualify either.

mergeReview.packageResolution: All scripts exactly536c, all non-script fields exactlyControls9f9, preserving atomic IndexedDB -> private-event-query -> reorg-anchor bootstrap order. All other tree blobs are the exact unambiguous three-way parent union.
mergeReview.limits: Old canonical generated artifacts remain historical for their sources. Combined new Noir+rc3 source requires fresh complete normal build/catalog/SDK/runtime qualification. Queue pin repair is separately owned and not approved by this merge check.
